description.value:
You gain resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and sonic damage for the duration.

Whenever you take damage of one of those types, you can use your reaction to convert your resistance into immunity to that damage type, applying even to the triggering damage; doing so ends the resistance to all five types, grants immunity until the end of your next turn, and then ends the power.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 6
